desc.zh: 刻了什麼一生一世的法文，看著嫌煩。隨便賣，買去點菸點煙火都行，別跟我談感情。
desc.zh_cn: 刻了什么一生一世的法文，看着嫌烦。随便卖，买去点烟点烟火都行，别跟我谈感情。
desc.en: Engraved with some French nonsense about 'forever.' Annoying to look at. Buy it to light your cigarettes or fireworks, just don't talk to me about feelings.

name.zh_cn: 穿过一次的骚粉色真丝衬衫
name.en: Worn Once Hot Pink Silk Shirt

desc.zh: 昨晚去夜店隨手抓的一件，沾了點不知道哪個女人的香水味。懶得送洗，便宜處理了，反正我從不穿第二次。
desc.zh_cn: 昨晚去夜店随手抓的一件，沾了点不知道哪个女人的香水味。懒得送洗，便宜处理了，反正我从不穿第二次。
desc.en: Grabbed this randomly for the club last night. Smells like some woman's perfume now. Too lazy to dry clean, selling it cheap. I never wear things twice anyway.

name.zh: 巴卡拉水晶威士忌酒杯（缺一隻）
name.zh_cn: 巴卡拉水晶威士忌酒杯（缺一只）

desc.zh: 本來是一對。前幾天Remy那傢伙在我這喝悶酒，為個小情人發脾氣砸了一隻。剩下的單著看礙眼，拿走。
desc.zh_cn: 本来是一对。前几天Remy那家伙在我这喝闷酒，为个小情人发脾气砸了一只。剩下的单着看碍眼，拿走。
desc.en: Used to be a pair. Remy was sulking over his little pet here the other night and smashed one in a lover's tantrum. The remaining one is an eyesore alone. Take it.

items.imgPrompt: A luxurious, unopened perfume box wrapped in clear cellophane, sitting on a dark leather car seat, gold accents, elegant design, natural daylight.

desc.zh: 本來要哄個小模特，結果她居然妄想查我的崗。直接拉黑了，香水沒拆，誰愛要誰要，別耽誤我泡吧。
desc.zh_cn: 本来要哄个小模特，结果她居然妄想查我的岗。直接拉黑了，香水没拆，谁爱要谁要，别耽误我泡吧。
desc.en: Meant to coax a little model with this, but she actually had the audacity to check up on me. Blocked her. Unopened, whoever wants it can have it, don't delay my clubbing.

items.imgPrompt: An empty, polished mahogany luxury watch box with a beige velvet interior, sitting open on a glass shelf, slightly dusty on the outside, soft lighting.

desc.zh: 錶太多，這破盒子佔著我衣帽間的地方。五十塊當交個朋友，雖然我不缺朋友。郵費自理。
desc.zh_cn: 表太多，这破盒子占着我衣帽间的地方。五十块当交个朋友，虽然我不缺朋友。邮费自理。
desc.en: Too many watches, this stupid box is taking up space in my walk-in closet. 50 bucks to make a friend, though I don't lack friends. Buyer pays shipping.
